principle: Software project machinery remains fully capable while its provider-specific language stays behind the interface boundary.

states.diverged: Two versions need to be reconciled

editing_collision.title: Editing collision
editing_collision.message: Someone else updated this project while we were working. Your work is safe. We need to refresh the Project Folder and reconcile the overlapping changes before saving again.

safety_check_failed.title: Safety check needs attention
safety_check_failed.message: The automated safety checks found something that should be fixed before this update becomes official.
safety_check_failed.action: Show the problem and prepare a fix

missing_item.title: Item not found
missing_item.message: I cannot find that file or Project Folder. It may have been moved, removed, renamed, or made private.

access_denied.title: Access needs to be restored
access_denied.message: We do not currently have the digital keys needed to change this project. You may have been signed out or the owner may need to grant access.

moving_too_fast.title: The service needs a moment
moving_too_fast.message: We are sending updates faster than the connected service can process them. Your work is safe. We can retry after a short pause.

system_hiccup.title: Temporary service hiccup
system_hiccup.message: The connected project service is temporarily unavailable. Your local work is safe, and nothing needs to be recreated.

system_tracking_error.title: Project tracking needs repair
system_tracking_error.message: The current files are no longer attached to an active Draft Version. Your files are still present. We need to return them to a recent Save Point before continuing.

unknown.title: Project operation could not finish
unknown.message: The system could not finish that project operation. Your existing work has not been discarded.

responseContract.technicalDetails: Technical details must be stored in a private Receipt and omitted from normal user output.
responseContract.rawIdentifiers: Provider identifiers may be retained internally but are hidden unless Developer View is explicitly enabled.
